name: Koa Health Foundations
one_liner: Koa Health's self-guided mental health app for employees, now named Koa Care 360; see the Koa Health listing.
best_for: Adults whose employer, health plan or provider offers Koa
People who want short CBT, mindfulness and sleep exercises
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People without access through an employer, health plan or provider
short_description: Koa Foundations was Koa Health's self-guided well-being app; Koa no longer lists it by that name, and the same App Store app is now Koa Care 360.
long_description: Koa Foundations was Koa Health's self-guided app of short activities based on cognitive behavioral therapy, mindfulness and positive psychology, offered through employers and partners such as International SOS. Koa's current product list no longer names Foundations, and the App Store app is now called Koa Care 360. A randomized trial of Foundations in NHS staff is listed on the Koa Health record. This record is kept for reference and points to Koa Health.

pricing.starting_price: Free through your employer, health plan or provider

privacy.notes: Koa's privacy policy could not be opened for this review; the App Store label lists health, contact and usage data linked to you and declares no tracking.

clinical_trials.study: England-wide RCT of Koa Foundations in NHS healthcare workers (King's College London)

citation.authors: Gnanapragasam SN, Tinch-Taylor R, Scott HR, Hegarty S, Souliou E, Bhundia R, Lamb D, Weston D, Greenberg N, Madan I, Stevelink S, Raine R, Carter B, Wessely S
citation.title: Multicentre, England-wide randomised controlled trial of the 'Foundations' smartphone application in improving mental health and well-being in a healthcare worker population

clinical_trials.outcome: App users had small but significant improvements in distress and well-being and less insomnia at 4 and 8 weeks versus control.

patient_summary: Koa Foundations is now part of the Koa Care 360 app, which you get free through an employer, health plan or provider. See the Koa Health listing for how it works and what the research shows.

availability.note: Now offered as Koa Care 360, only through an employer, health plan or provider; adults 18+.
